module purpose: neorv32_cpu_icc bridges CSR accesses to an ICC interface. It returns incoming ICC status/data on csr_rdata_o, generates an output read event on icc_tx_o.ack for CSR reads of the ICC data register, and feeds CSR write data through a FIFO to the outgoing ICC data path.

use-case flows.value: status-register bits reporting the incoming ready state and the FIFO status bit on csr_rdata_o
incoming ICC data word returned on csr_rdata_o when the data register is selected and the incoming ready bit is 1
output event on icc_tx_o.ack when a CSR read targets the ICC data register
write-enable decision that lets a CSR write target the transmit FIFO
CSR write data presented to the transmit FIFO and FIFO output exported on the outgoing ICC interface

conceptual assets.concept: CSR write selection for the transmit FIFO
conceptual assets.reasoning: Line 60 computes tx_fifo_we from csr_we_i and the exact ICC data-register address, and line 82 sends that decision to tx_queue_inst.we_i. The transmit-write flow depends on this decision because it determines whether a CSR write is accepted by the FIFO. Corruption would enqueue an unintended write or suppress an intended one, so Integrity is established; Availability is also established under the line-60 condition.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit payload supplied by CSR writes and delivered on the outgoing ICC data path
conceptual assets.reasoning: Line 81 delivers csr_wdata_i to tx_queue_inst.wdata_i, line 82 qualifies acceptance with tx_fifo_we, and line 86 delivers the FIFO output to icc_tx_o.dat. Under the RTL-visible delivery path into the sub-unit and out through this entity's boundary, Integrity is established for the transmitted word: the downstream consumer should receive exactly the value this entity presents on that path.

conceptual assets.concept: Output event indicating that a CSR read targets the ICC data register
conceptual assets.reasoning: Line 59 drives icc_tx_o.ack high exactly when csr_re_i = '1' and csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c, else it drives 0. This is a module-produced event for another block, so Integrity is established: the consumer must see the event only for that read condition. Availability is established under the same condition.

In the status-register branch, line 48 copies the incoming ready bit to csr_rdata_o(0). The same input also qualifies data-register readout at line 51 before line 52 can return data. Integrity of this status value is established because both the reported status and the data-read qualification depend on it; Availability is established for the addressed status-read path.

When the data-register branch is selected and icc_rx_i.rdy = '1', line 52 copies icc_rx_i.dat to csr_rdata_o. Integrity is established because the CSR read-out flow depends on returning exactly that input word. Availability is established only under the RTL-visible conditions at lines 51-52.

conceptual assets.concept: CSR-visible FIFO status bit returned in csr_rdata_o(1)
conceptual assets.reasoning: On status-register reads, line 49 copies tx_fifo_free into csr_rdata_o(1), and line 83 brings that value into this entity from tx_queue_inst.free_o. Integrity is established because the CSR report flow depends on returning the exact sub-block status bit; Availability is established for the addressed status-read path.
